what: Every retrieval filter and journal list in this repository, with its default role. Generated by scripts/catalog.mjs; do not edit by hand.
roles: Defined in neurosymbolic_router.json composition.roles. The role is a default: the question decides (composition.facet_roles).

validation_values.author_made: The header says it is the author's own work. Never present it as validated.
validation_values.adapted_from_reference: Adapted from a published filter. The stored version is not the validated one.
validation_values.reference_cited: The header cites a reference. That alone does not prove the stored version is the validated one.
